datasets.name: account_profile
datasets.description: Current account profile and its relationship to a customer.

fields.name: customer_type
fields.description: Customer type associated with the account.

fields.name: record_arrival_date
fields.description: Date on which the current account record arrived.

dialects.expression: CASE WHEN account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

datasets.name: transaction_activity
datasets.description: Current transaction activity and its account relationship for factual analysis.

fields.name: originating_country
fields.description: Country from which the transaction originated.

fields.name: destination_country
fields.description: Country to which the transaction was directed.

fields.name: transaction_date
fields.description: Date on which the transaction occurred.

fields.name: record_arrival_date
fields.description: Date on which the current transaction record arrived.

fields.name: cross_border

dialects.expression: case when originating_country is not null and destination_country is not null and originating_country <> destination_country then 'Y' else 'N' end

fields.description: Indicates whether transaction origin and destination countries differ.

dialects.expression: CASE WHEN transaction_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

fields.name: total_transaction_amount
fields.description: Total amount across current transaction records.

fields.name: average_transaction_amount
fields.description: Average amount across current transaction records.

dialects.expression: case when originating_country is not null and destination_country is not null and originating_country <> destination_country then 1 else 0 end

datasets.name: customer_profile
datasets.description: Current customer profile used as the factual input for customer risk assessment.

fields.name: country_of_residence
fields.description: Country in which the customer currently resides.

fields.name: country_of_birth
fields.description: Country in which the customer was born.

fields.name: record_arrival_date
fields.description: Date on which the current customer record arrived.

dialects.expression: CASE WHEN cust_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
